title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I intend to buy shares of shariah compliant companies with a intention of investment / business. Once these shares come into my posession, can i sell them immediately if I notice that the price is going down? Is there any minimum time frame that i need to wait before I sell them on moral ground? 4861 views Q. I have gone through the previous fatwas of Dar-ul-Ifta about the investment in stock market. I have come to know now that I have to invest in which type of companies. But my question is related to my previous investments. I have already invested in some on the companies which are not fulfilling sharia complaince criteria. I obviously have to get rid of such companies and I have to sell the shares of such companies. But will the profit I will get will be haram? As i didnt knew before this criteria of sharia compliance. Some of the companies in which I have invested I am getting profit and in some loss at this time but profit is more than loss. Please advise about such profit. Regards, Rana Khawar 5415 views Q. Salam Alaykum, I used to do investment in Mutual funds wherein when the sensex goes up I used to get fund value high and when the sensex goes down I use to get fund value low. The fund value is the value which I am supposed to withdraw. For example If I invested for an amount of Rs. 5000. Based on the market condition I will be having this amount either 4000 or 6000 and can go higher or lower. Kindly let me know is this a genuine by Islam. 6463 views Q. I am trading in share market, I want to know that if i sold shares in the morning after market starts and buy shares (which i sold in the morning or before some time) after some time in that day before closing the market, which is called short position/transaction, is it HALAL or HARAM? 5380 views Q. 400 people have bought share in a comapny, one share cost 1000. the comapny has bought 2 Houses. answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Shares & Investments Question ID: 42937 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: sharing condition in business Question: We want to start a business. We are totally three partners. One of the sleeping partners is interested to invest maximum amount, while rest of partially less working partners are investing less amount. We have agreed to distribute the annual net profit percentage not equally according to the money invested but 35%, 35% and 30%. Is this permissible as other two partners are not investing much amount as the 1st one? Moreover to run this business we are employing one person on monthly salary + other medical/ travelling expenses, in addition we agreed to give him 2% profit annually as an incentive on the net income profit what we earn from our business. We want to know is it permissible for him to get the monthly salary as well as 2% profit as an incentive from our business. Answer ID: 42937 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 51/59/D=1434) It is lawful to give the employee 2% as prize except salary out of the yearly profit of business. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
